Title: Colorful Tree
About This Work: A small weekend project inspired by youtube how-to videos.  It  uses a 3 paint pallette mixed to achieve light shadow and the attention getting leaf color.

Title: Imperial City at Sunset
About This Work: This painting is a landscape of the Imperial City of Cyrodil. It was inspired while playing the video game Oblivion.  A screenshot was taken in game and it was brought to life in this small painting.

Title: The Village Lighthouse
About This Work: From Thomas Kinkade: The Village Lighthouse portrays a village nestled into a rocky shore that I discovered on a seaside stroll in England. The stalwart cottages are built of the same granite that rises in cliffs from the sea. A radiant glow bathes the village, touching the magnificent flowering dogwood and lavish stands of foxgloves and impatiens with light, just as it illuminates the waves that dance over the ocean. Wisps of spray rise from the waves while plumes of smoke ascend from the chimneys. Land and sea; man and nature are in perfect harmony here.

Title: Along Oyster Creek
About This Work: This work was completed by local Lake Jackson, TX artist Dorothy Salisbury,  Oyster Creek runs through the area and is characterized by a swampy slow moving water often sourrounded by large trees and hanging spainish moss.  This essence is captured by the use of greens and subtle browns with the centerpiece being a large broken tree hanging down towards the water.
